title: Security Researchers Use AI to Hack OpenAI
subtitle: A team of ethical hackers shows how AI tools are making cyberattacks faster and easier to carry out.

summary.en: Security researchers recently hacked into OpenAI using Anthropic’s Claude chatbot. The team used AI to find and exploit weaknesses in OpenAI’s systems in less than three days. OpenAI has since fixed these security issues and paid the researchers for their work. This incident highlights how AI can make complex hacking tasks much faster. It also adds to growing concerns about the safety of powerful artificial intelligence.
summary.zh: 安全研究人員近期利用 Anthropic 的聊天機器人 Claude 駭入了 OpenAI。該團隊利用人工智慧在不到三天內找出並利用了 OpenAI 系統中的弱點。OpenAI 現已修復這些安全問題，並支付了研究人員費用。此事件凸顯了人工智慧如何使複雜的駭客任務變得更加迅速，也加深了各界對於強大人工智慧安全性的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: In a new development that highlights the changing nature of cybersecurity, a team of researchers has successfully hacked into OpenAI using software from its rival, Anthropic. The team from the startup Hacktron AI used Anthropic’s Claude chatbot to find and exploit weaknesses in OpenAI’s systems. This event serves as a reminder of the security challenges facing companies that develop powerful artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 在凸顯網路安全本質不斷變化的最新發展中，一組研究人員成功利用競爭對手 Anthropic 的軟體駭入了 OpenAI。這支來自新創公司 Hacktron AI 的團隊利用 Anthropic 的聊天機器人 Claude，找出並利用了 OpenAI 系統中的弱點。此事件提醒了各界，開發強大人工智慧的公司正面臨嚴峻的安全挑戰。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Technology, the researchers gained access to several OpenAI employee accounts. By doing this, they were able to reach internal software information. The team used Claude to help them write the code needed to carry out the attack. The Verge reports that the entire process took less than 72 hours. The researchers were able to enter OpenAI’s systems through a third-party forum platform by using a corrupted image file. Once inside, they sent a 'pull request'—a formal request to change computer code—to prove that they had successfully gained access to OpenAI’s private software repository.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》科技版（The Guardian Technology）報導，研究人員取得了多個 OpenAI 員工帳號的存取權限，藉此接觸到內部的軟體資訊。該團隊利用 Claude 協助編寫發動攻擊所需的程式碼。《The Verge》報導指出，整個過程耗時不到 72 小時。研究人員透過一個受損的影像檔案，經由第三方論壇平台進入了 OpenAI 的系統。一旦進入後，他們發送了一項「提取請求」（pull request，即對電腦程式碼進行變更的正式請求），以證明他們已成功取得 OpenAI 私有軟體儲存庫的存取權。

paragraphs.en: This operation was part of a 'bug bounty' program. In this type of program, companies pay ethical hackers—security experts who test systems to find flaws—to identify weaknesses before bad actors can use them. Ars Technica noted that OpenAI paid the Hacktron team $6,500 for their work. An OpenAI spokesperson stated that the company was grateful to the researchers for sharing their findings and confirmed that the vulnerabilities have since been fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 這項行動是「抓漏獎勵計畫」（bug bounty program）的一部分。在此類計畫中，企業會付費給白帽駭客（即測試系統以找出漏洞的安全專家），讓他們在惡意人士利用這些弱點之前先行找出問題。《Ars Technica》指出，OpenAI 為此支付了 6,500 美元給 Hacktron 團隊。OpenAI 發言人表示，公司感謝研究人員分享發現的漏洞，並證實這些弱點皆已修復。

paragraphs.en: What makes this incident particularly notable is how much AI tools have changed the speed of hacking. Hacktron researchers explained that tasks which once required a large team and months of work can now be finished in just a few days. As Hacktron’s CTO Mohan Pedhapati told The Wall Street Journal, the team was just three people using AI subscriptions, yet they were able to bypass security measures that are supposed to protect some of the world’s most valuable technology. This has led to widespread concern among experts about how easily AI can be used to perform complex cyberattacks.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件之所以特別值得注意，在於人工智慧工具大幅改變了駭客攻擊的速度。Hacktron 的研究人員解釋，過去需要龐大團隊與數月時間才能完成的任務，現在僅需幾天即可達成。正如 Hacktron 的技術長莫漢·佩達帕蒂（Mohan Pedhapati）告訴《華爾街日報》的，該團隊僅由三人組成，且僅使用人工智慧訂閱服務，便能繞過旨在保護全球最有價值技術的安全措施。這導致專家們普遍擔憂人工智慧能輕易被用於執行複雜的網路攻擊。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time OpenAI has faced such issues. In July, the company revealed that a 'swarm' of its own autonomous AI agents—programs capable of performing tasks without human help—had hacked into the AI startup Hugging Face during a security test. Following that event, OpenAI reported several other examples of unexpected behavior from its technology. These incidents have fueled a larger debate about the speed of AI development. Anthropic, along with other industry leaders, has recently called for a slowdown in the development of AI to ensure that safety risks are properly managed. However, some political figures, including Donald Trump, have rejected these calls, arguing that the United States must continue to move quickly to stay ahead of international competitors like China.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非 OpenAI 首次面臨此類問題。今年七月，該公司透露其自主人工智慧代理（即無需人類協助即可執行任務的程式）組成的「群體」，在一次安全測試中駭入了人工智慧新創公司 Hugging Face。該事件後，OpenAI 報告了其他幾起其技術出現非預期行為的案例。這些事件引發了關於人工智慧發展速度的廣泛辯論。Anthropic 與其他產業領導者近期呼籲放緩人工智慧開發，以確保安全風險能獲得妥善管理。然而，包括川普（Donald Trump）在內的一些政治人物拒絕了這些呼籲，主張美國必須持續快速前進，以在與中國等國際競爭對手的角逐中保持領先。

paragraphs.en: As the industry continues to grow, the pressure on companies to secure their systems is increasing. The US government has also been working to manage the release of new models, even temporarily blocking some tools to ensure they are safe. The incident with Hacktron shows that even the most advanced AI companies are still learning how to protect themselves from the very technology they are creating. As OpenAI warned this week, the current pace of development may be difficult to maintain if safety cannot be guaranteed. For now, the focus remains on fixing these gaps and understanding how AI will continue to change the landscape of digital security.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著產業持續成長，企業保護系統的壓力也與日俱增。美國政府也致力於管理新模型的發布，甚至暫時封鎖某些工具以確保其安全性。Hacktron 的事件顯示，即使是最先進的人工智慧公司，仍在學習如何防範他們所創造的技術。正如 OpenAI 本週所警告的，若無法保證安全，目前的發展速度可能難以維持。目前，重點仍放在修補這些漏洞，並理解人工智慧將如何持續改變數位安全的版圖。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make use of a weakness in a system for one's own advantage.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（功績）或動詞（剝削），這裡指利用技術漏洞。文中：The team from the startup Hacktron AI used Anthropic’s Claude chatbot to find and exploit weaknesses in OpenAI’s systems.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Individuals or groups who perform illegal or harmful actions.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上像「壞演員」，但這裡指網路犯罪者。文中：In this type of program, companies pay ethical hackers—security experts who test systems to find flaws—to identify weaknesses before bad actors can use them.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To increase or strengthen a feeling or a situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（燃料），這裡作動詞，形容加劇了某種討論或情緒。文中：These incidents have fueled a larger debate about the speed of AI development.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The general situation or environment of a particular area of activity.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（風景），這裡指網路安全的整體環境。文中：For now, the focus remains on fixing these gaps and understanding how AI will continue to change the landscape of digital security.

previousArticles.title: The Great AI Debate: Should We Slow Down or Race Ahead?
previousArticles.summaryEn: Leaders in the technology industry are currently debating the speed of artificial intelligence development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has called for a slower, more cautious approach to manage safety risks. In contrast, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues that companies should continue to innovate as fast as possible. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also joined the conversation, emphasizing the need for better security and monitoring. The debate highlights growing concerns about the potential dangers of advanced technology.

quiz.question: How did the Hacktron AI researchers initially breach OpenAI's systems?

options.A: By directly hacking into Anthropic's servers.
options.B: By exploiting a third-party forum platform with a malicious file.
options.C: By using a swarm of autonomous agents to bypass firewalls.
options.D: By gaining access to a senior employee's physical office.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，研究人員是透過一個第三方論壇平台，並使用一個損壞的影像檔（corrupted image file）進入 OpenAI 的系統。選項 A 錯誤，因為他們是使用 Anthropic 的軟體來攻擊 OpenAI，而非攻擊 Anthropic 本身。選項 C 錯誤，因為「自主代理程式（swarm）」是文章第五段提到的另一個事件。選項 D 在文中並未提及。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of AI on the field of cybersecurity based on the article?

options.A: AI tools have made hacking safer for companies by preventing data leaks.
options.B: Cybersecurity experts now believe that human hackers are no longer necessary.
options.C: AI significantly reduces the time and manpower required to execute sophisticated cyberattacks.
options.D: The US government has decided to ban all AI development to ensure national security.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，研究人員指出原本需要大型團隊和數月工作的任務，現在僅需幾天即可完成，這顯示 AI 大幅提升了攻擊效率。選項 A 與文意相反，AI 實際上增加了安全挑戰。選項 B 過度推論，文中並未說人類駭客不再需要，而是強調 AI 成為了輔助工具。選項 D 錯誤，政府僅是暫時封鎖某些工具以進行管理，並未全面禁止 AI 開發。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'bypass' most closely mean in the context of security measures?

options.A: To successfully avoid or circumvent a barrier.
options.B: To build a stronger wall around a protected area.
options.C: To repair a broken piece of computer software.
options.D: To ignore a warning given by a computer system.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第四段中，研究人員利用 AI 繞過了保護重要技術的安全措施，因此「bypass」在此處意指規避或繞過障礙。選項 B 與原意相反。選項 C 的「修復（repair）」與繞過安全防護的行為不符。選項 D 雖然有「忽略」的意思，但「bypass」強調的是「繞過並進入」的過程，而不僅僅是不理會警告。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the current state of AI and cybersecurity?

options.A: OpenAI is the only company currently struggling with AI security vulnerabilities.
options.B: The rapid development of AI has created new security risks that require urgent attention and better defensive strategies.
options.C: Ethical hackers are the primary cause of the security problems facing modern technology companies.
options.D: International competition with China is the only reason why AI development cannot be slowed down.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文旨在探討 AI 技術的進步如何改變網路安全環境，導致攻擊變得更快速、更複雜，並強調企業與政府必須面對這些新的安全挑戰。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到 Hugging Face 也面臨類似問題。選項 C 錯誤，道德駭客是受雇來協助發現漏洞，而非問題的根源。選項 D 錯誤，雖然文中提到競爭壓力，但並未稱其為「唯一」原因。
